Kira (Docs): Quick thread to finish the changelog entry for today's docs push. Need 3 bullets + one short known-issue line. Also confirm snippet rename for embeddings. I'll open the PR in ~5m.
Jon (SDK): Confirming API rename: `client.embeddings.create()` -> `client.embeddings.generate()` across docs. I'll push a snippet PR and add redirects. Snippet example: ```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
resp = client.embeddings.generate(model="embed-lite-v2", input="hello")
print(len(resp.vector))
```
Hanna (Eng): Note for known issue: quantized embeddings can slightly change magnitudes; runtime >=2026-03-25 has mitigations. Suggest one-line: "Quantized embedding models may change vector magnitudes; re-check NN thresholds."
Sam (Release): Marketing wants lead sentence: "Reducing failovers, trimming cost, and smoothing SDK upgrades." Keep bullets short. Staging window at 18:00 PT.
Kira (Docs): Draft bullets: - Automatic fallback to compatible model variants (reduces downtime) - Optimize: quantization suggestion UI + batch hints - Docs: unified v2 SDK snippets and embeddings API rename Known issue: Quantized embedding models may change vector magnitudes; re-check nearest-neighbor thresholds after upgrading.
link-bot: link-check: running `tools/linkcheck --path docs --ignore /experimental`
Jon (SDK): PRs opened: snippets (GH #5510) and redirects (GH #5511). I'll run linkcheck locally and update any broken anchors.
Kira (Docs): Great — I'll merge the changelog entry after the staging smoke tests pass. Thanks everyone! :white_check_mark:
